prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have consistently shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
'sign_in, reorder' changes have consistently shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', and 'finish, redesign' changes, as test results disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been overestimated compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +0.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.2%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] waiting_time_estimate_display: Displays an estimated time and progress bar on the waiting screen while the pet is being generated. (why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off without status feedback.)
1: [home, new_screen] home_desktop_prep_stage: Adds a dedicated desktop preparation checklist screen while the pet environment is initializing. (why: Addresses desktop visibility issues reported in support mail and structures the long 201s median wait time into clear progress steps.)
2: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_split_layout: Changes the path selection screen layout to a split view showing side-by-side path comparisons. (why: The choose_path screen currently loses 23.8% of users with an 8s median / 514s mean time.)
3: [finish, new_flow] finish_interactive_controls_flow: Appends a new interactive pet controls walkthrough flow after the home intro screen. (why: Support receives multiple complaints about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
4: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_lighting_hint: Displays clear photo quality and lighting tips directly on the photo upload screen. (why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.)
5: [finish, redesign] home_intro_stage_redesign: Redesigns the home intro screen using a stage layout spotlighting the active desktop pet. (why: Finishing onboarding overall is only 23.8%, and home intro takes a median of 395s.)
6: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_existing_pet_notice: Shows a helpful note reminding users to sign in with their existing account to keep previously created pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets going missing or resetting after users sign in again.)
7: [home, notification] waiting_notify_ready_toggle: Adds a notification toggle option on the waiting screen so users get notified when generation completes. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s, leading to abandoned desktop sessions.)
8: [choose_path, redesign] story_card_layout_redesign: Redesigns the initial intro story screen into a clean card layout focused on desktop pet features. (why: The first step (choose_path/story) sees a 23.8% drop-off right at the start of onboarding.)
